lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
عَزِِيزٌ ʿazız [quasi‐act. part./n., pl. أَعِزَّةٌ ʾaʿizzatun]

1 mighty, powerful

(39:37) ‏أَلَيْسَ‏ ‏اللَّهُ‏ ‏بِعَزِيزٍ‏ ‏ذِي‏ ‏انْتِقَامٍ‏ is God not All‐Mighty and capable of retribution?; *

(36:38) العَزِيز [an attribute of God] the Mighty

2 ruler, governor, chief

(12:30) ‏امْرَأَةُ‏ ‏الْعَزِيزِ‏ ‏تُرَاوِدُ‏ ‏فَتَاهَا‏ ‏عَنْ‏ ‏نَفْسِهِ‏ the governor’s wife is trying to seduce her slave

3 dear, precious

(44:49) ذُقْ‏ ‏إِنَّكَ‏ ‏أَنْتَ‏ ‏الْعَزِيزُ‏ ‏الْكَرِيمُ‏ taste this [punishment], you precious one!

4 honourable, with some status, respected

(11:91)‏وَمَا‏ ‏أَنْتَ‏ ‏عَلَيْنَا‏ ‏بِعَزِيز and you [yourself] are of no consquence among us

5 well constructed, invincible, impregnable

(41:41–2)‏وَإِنَّهُ‏ ‏لَكِتَابٌ‏ ‏عَزِيزٌ لاَ‏ ‏يَأْتِيهِ‏ ‏الْبَاطِلُ‏‏‏ it is, indeed, an impregnable (or, a mighty/powerful) Book which falsehood cannot reach

6 [with prep. عَلَي] difficult, troublesome, of great concern

(9:128) ‏عَزِيزٌ‏ ‏عَلَيْهِ‏ ‏مَا‏ ‏عَنِتُّمْ‏‏ distressing to him is your suffering.

entries.label: عَزِِيزٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
عَزِِيزٌ ʿazız [quasi‐act. part./n., pl. أَعِزَّةٌ ʾaʿizzatun]

1 mighty, powerful

(39:37) ‏أَلَيْسَ‏ ‏اللَّهُ‏ ‏بِعَزِيزٍ‏ ‏ذِي‏ ‏انْتِقَامٍ‏ is God not All‐Mighty and capable of retribution?; *

(36:38) العَزِيز [an attribute of God] the Mighty

2 ruler, governor, chief

(12:30) ‏امْرَأَةُ‏ ‏الْعَزِيزِ‏ ‏تُرَاوِدُ‏ ‏فَتَاهَا‏ ‏عَنْ‏ ‏نَفْسِهِ‏ the governor’s wife is trying to seduce her slave

3 dear, precious

(44:49) ذُقْ‏ ‏إِنَّكَ‏ ‏أَنْتَ‏ ‏الْعَزِيزُ‏ ‏الْكَرِيمُ‏ taste this [punishment], you precious one!

4 honourable, with some status, respected

(11:91)‏وَمَا‏ ‏أَنْتَ‏ ‏عَلَيْنَا‏ ‏بِعَزِيز and you [yourself] are of no consquence among us

5 well constructed, invincible, impregnable

(41:41–2)‏وَإِنَّهُ‏ ‏لَكِتَابٌ‏ ‏عَزِيزٌ لاَ‏ ‏يَأْتِيهِ‏ ‏الْبَاطِلُ‏‏‏ it is, indeed, an impregnable (or, a mighty/powerful) Book which falsehood cannot reach

6 [with prep. عَلَي] difficult, troublesome, of great concern

(9:128) ‏عَزِيزٌ‏ ‏عَلَيْهِ‏ ‏مَا‏ ‏عَنِتُّمْ‏‏ distressing to him is your suffering.

entries.label: أَعَزُّ
entries.definitionHtml:
أَعَزُّ ʾaʿazz [elat.]

1 more/most powerful, mightier/mightiest

(63:8) ‏لَيُخْرِجَنَّ‏ ‏الأَعَزُّ‏ ‏مِنْهَا‏ ‏الأَذَلَّ‏ the mightier will drive the more humble out of it

2 more respected, more esteemed

(11:92)‏أَرَهْطِي‏ ‏أَعَزُّ‏ ‏عَلَيْكُمْ‏ ‏مِنَ‏ ‏اللَّهِ‏ is my tribe more esteemed in your eyes than God?

entries.label: العُزَّى
entries.definitionHtml:
العُزَّى ʾal‐ʿuzzā [proper. n.] one of the idols widely worshipped in Arabia in pre‐Islamic times and considered by the pagan Arabs to be, together with Manāt and ʾallāt, God’s daughters

(53:19–21) أَفَرَأَيْتُمُ‏ ‏اللاَّتَ‏ ‏وَالْعُزَّى‏ ‏وَمَنَاةَ‏ ‏الثَّالِثَةَ‏ ‏الأُخْرَى‏ أَلَكُمُ‏ ‏الذَّكَرُ‏ ‏وَلَهُ‏ ‏الأُنْثَى‏ will you [disbelievers] consider [the case of] ʾallāt and ʾal‐ʿuzzā and that third one, Manāt!?–Are you to have the male and He the female?

entries.label: تُعِزُّ
entries.definitionHtml:
تُعِزُّ tuʿizz [imperf. of v. IV أعَزّ ʾaʿazza] to exalt, to give power to

(3:26) ‏‏وَتُعِزُّ‏ ‏مَنْ‏ ‏تَشَاءُ‏ ‏وَتُذِلُّ‏ ‏مَنْ‏ ‏تَشَاءُ You exalt whomever You will and abase whomever You will.

entries.label: عَزَّ
entries.definitionHtml:
عَزَّ ʿazza u [v. trans.] ‚to overcome, to prevail over, to get the better of

(38:23) ‏فَقَالَ‏ ‏أَكْفِلْنِيهَا‏ ‏وَعَزَّنِي‏ ‏فِى‏ ‏الْخِطَابِ‏ and he said, ‘Put her in my charge’, and he got the better of me in the argument.

entries.label: عَزَّزَ
entries.definitionHtml:
عَزَّزَ ʿazzaza [v. II trans.] to reinforce, to strengthen

(36:14) ‏فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا‏ ‏فَعَزَّزْنَا‏ ‏بِثَالِثٍ ‏but they rejected both, so We reinforced [them] with a third.

entries.label: عِزٌّ
entries.definitionHtml:
عِزٌّ ʿizz [v. n./n.] support, strength

(19:81) ‏لِيَكُونُوا‏ ‏لَهُمْ‏ ‏عِزًّا that they might be for them a support.

entries.label: عِزَّةٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
عِزَّةٌ ʿizzatun I [v. n.] feeling proud of *

(2:206)‏أَخَذَتْهُ‏ ‏الْعِزَّةُ‏ ‏بِالإِثْم ‏‏ he was too arrogant to accept [lit. his pride led him to persist in his sinful ways] II [n.]

1 power, support

(4:139) ‏فَإِنَّ‏ ‏الْعِزَّةَ‏ ‏لِلَّهِ‏ ‏جَمِيعًا all power is truly for God

2 glory, exaltation

(26:44)‏‏بِعِزَّةِ‏ ‏فِرْعَوْنَ‏ ‏إِنَّا‏ ‏لَنَحْنُ‏ ‏الْغَالِبُونَ‏ by Pharaoh’s might, we shall be the victors.
